## Summary

Describe the problem and the change.

## Validation

List the commands you ran and their results.

## Evidence and claims

Link any protocol, raw result, or reproducible script needed to support a
quantitative statement. State clearly when a result is preliminary or negative.

## Checklist

- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] `ruff check`, `ruff format --check`, `pytest`, and `build` pass locally.
- [ ] I did not add secrets, private data, caches, or generated build artifacts.
- [ ] Documentation and claims match the evidence included in this change.
